paper.citation: Hando BR et al. Dry Needling Plus Manual Therapy and Exercise for Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Sham-Controlled Randomized Clinical Trial. JOSPT 2026;56(1):50–63.

title.en: Dry Needling Plus Manual Therapy and Exercise for Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Sham-Controlled Randomized Clinical Trial
title.zh: 干针联合手法治疗与运动治疗肩峰下疼痛综合征：一项假干针对照随机临床试验

question.en: What additional effect does dry needling have when it is added to manual therapy and exercise for subacromial pain syndrome (SAPS)? The trial compared physical therapy (PT) alone, PT plus sham dry needling (PT + SDN), and PT plus dry needling (PT + DN). The PT comparison estimates the added effect of including dry needling in the treatment program, whereas the sham comparison also accounts for aspects of receiving a needling procedure, so the two comparisons address different questions.
question.zh: 在手法治疗与运动治疗的基础上加用干针，对肩峰下疼痛综合征（SAPS）有什么额外效果？试验比较了单纯物理治疗（PT）、物理治疗加假干针（PT + SDN），以及物理治疗加干针（PT + DN）。与 PT 组的比较估计在治疗方案中加入干针的额外效果；与假干针组的比较还考虑了接受针刺程序所涉及的部分因素，因此这两项比较回答的问题不同。

design.en: A sham-controlled randomized clinical trial with three groups: PT (manual therapy and exercise), PT + SDN, and PT + DN. This appraisal is based on the results abstract and the public study protocol; the full results article has not been obtained. A protocol records planned methods and cannot establish how the trial was actually conducted. The paper identifies trial registration NCT03442894, but the current registry contents and amendment history have not been verified.
design.zh: 这是一项假干针对照随机临床试验，分为三组：PT（手法治疗与运动治疗）、PT + SDN 和 PT + DN。本评价依据结果摘要与公开研究方案，尚未取得结果论文全文。研究方案记录的是计划采用的方法，不能据此确认试验实际怎样执行。论文注明的试验登记号为 NCT03442894，但注册页面的当前内容与修改历史尚未核验。

population.en: The results abstract reports 121 participants with subacromial pain syndrome (SAPS). The planned sample in the protocol was 130; this difference is not a count of participants lost to follow-up. Group-specific missingness and reasons for dropout remain unverified.
population.zh: 结果摘要报告 121 名肩峰下疼痛综合征（SAPS）患者。研究方案计划的样本量为 130 人；这一差额并不是失访人数。各组缺失数据的分布与退出原因仍未核实。

methods.en: All three groups received physical therapy consisting of manual therapy and exercise; two groups additionally received sham dry needling or dry needling. The primary outcome was the Shoulder Pain and Disability Index (SPADI) at 1 year; secondary outcomes included the Patient Acceptable Symptom State (PASS) and additional shoulder-related care within 1 year. The protocol planned sequentially numbered, opaque, sealed envelopes for allocation concealment, blinding of participants receiving real or sham needling to that distinction, and analysis in the originally assigned groups. Whether these planned procedures were implemented as planned remains unverified.
methods.zh: 三组都接受由手法治疗与运动治疗组成的物理治疗，其中两组另外加用假干针或干针。主要结局是 1 年时的肩痛与功能障碍指数（SPADI）；次要结局包括患者可接受症状状态（PASS），以及入组后 1 年内再次因肩部问题就医。研究方案计划采用顺序编号、不透明且密封的信封进行分配隐藏，使接受真干针或假干针的患者不知道自己接受的是哪一种，并按照最初随机分配的组别进行分析。这些计划程序是否按计划落实，仍未核实。

results.en: As reported in the abstract, the 1-year SPADI difference was −7.51 (95% CI −16.57 to 1.54) for PT + DN vs PT and −9.85 (95% CI −18.98 to 0.73) for PT + DN vs PT + SDN; both intervals include zero, so the primary comparisons did not reach statistical significance. At 6 months, absolute PASS differences were +34 percentage points (95% CI +14 to +55 percentage points) for PT + DN vs PT and +24 percentage points (95% CI +4 to +45 percentage points) for PT + DN vs PT + SDN; at 1 year, +28 percentage points (95% CI +7 to +49 percentage points) for PT + DN vs PT + SDN. For additional shoulder-related care within 1 year, the reported odds ratio (OR) was 0.35 (95% CI, 0.13–0.95); the abstract does not identify the reference group. An odds ratio cannot be directly restated as a risk reduction, so this value should not be described as a 65% reduction in risk.
results.zh: 按摘要所载，1 年 SPADI 组间差值为：PT + DN 对比 PT −7.51（95% 置信区间 −16.57 到 1.54），PT + DN 对比 PT + SDN −9.85（95% 置信区间 −18.98 到 0.73）；两项置信区间都包含 0，因此主要比较未达到统计学显著性。6 个月时，PASS 的绝对差值为：PT + DN 对比 PT +34 个百分点（95% 置信区间 +14 至 +55 个百分点），PT + DN 对比 PT + SDN +24 个百分点（95% 置信区间 +4 至 +45 个百分点）；1 年时，PT + DN 对比 PT + SDN 为 +28 个百分点（95% 置信区间 +7 至 +49 个百分点）。对于入组后 1 年内再次因肩部问题就医，摘要报告的优势比（OR）为 0.35（95% 置信区间 0.13–0.95）；摘要未说明参照组。优势比不能直接改写为风险降低的比例，因此不能把这个数值描述为“风险降低 65%”。

limitations.en: This appraisal rests on the results abstract and the protocol only: the full results article was not obtained, the registry was not checked, and the appraisal is not a complete risk-of-bias assessment. Adequate allocation concealment, masking success, the handling of missing data, multiplicity adjustment, and adverse-event reporting all remain unverified, and missing verification is not evidence that a method was omitted. The protocol abstract lists SPADI and PROMIS-57, whereas its statistical section specifies 1-year SPADI as the primary endpoint; this wording difference alone does not establish outcome switching. The protocol planned database and record-based health care data, whereas the results abstract describes self-report; this difference and the OR reference group remain unresolved.
limitations.zh: 本评价只依据结果摘要与研究方案：尚未取得结果论文全文，也未核验注册页面，因此并不构成完整的偏倚风险评价。分配隐藏是否充分落实、盲法是否成功、缺失数据如何处理、是否进行多重比较校正以及不良事件报告情况都仍未核实，而未能核实某项方法，不等于有证据表明研究未实施该方法。研究方案摘要列出 SPADI 和 PROMIS-57，但其统计部分将 1 年时的 SPADI 明确定为主要终点；仅凭这处措辞差异，不能认定发生了结局更换。研究方案计划通过数据库及病历收集就医数据，结果摘要则描述为患者自报；这一差异以及 OR 的参照组仍待厘清。

applicability.en: In this appraisal's interpretation, the trial did not establish an additional benefit of dry needling on 1-year SPADI; this does not establish equivalence or prove that dry needling has no effect. Favorable secondary findings warrant cautious, outcome-specific interpretation and cannot replace the primary result. The results cannot be generalized to every dry-needling protocol, all shoulder pain, or acupuncture as a whole.
applicability.zh: 按本评价的解读，这项试验未能在 1 年 SPADI 上确立加用干针的额外获益；这并不等于证明各组等效，也不等于证明干针没有作用。有利的次要发现应按具体结局谨慎解释，不能用来替代主要结果。结果不能推广到所有干针方案、全部肩痛患者，或针灸整体。

explanation.en: Randomization determines group assignment; allocation concealment prevents advance knowledge of the next assignment during enrollment. The protocol planned sequentially numbered, opaque, sealed envelopes, and whether this procedure was implemented adequately remains unverified.
explanation.zh: 随机化用于确定分组；分配隐藏用于防止在入组过程中提前知道下一次分配结果。研究方案计划采用顺序编号、不透明且密封的信封，该程序是否得到充分落实，仍未核实。

explanation.en: The comparison with PT alone estimates the added effect of including dry needling in the treatment program. The comparison with sham dry needling also accounts for aspects of receiving a needling procedure, so the two comparisons address different questions.
explanation.zh: 与单纯 PT 组的比较估计在治疗方案中加入干针的额外效果；与假干针组的比较还考虑了接受针刺程序所涉及的部分因素，因此这两项比较回答的问题不同。

explanation.en: The protocol planned to blind participants receiving real or sham needling to that distinction. Participants in the no-needling group would know their assignment, and treating clinicians could not be blinded to the treatment delivered. Actual masking success and unmasking require the results report.
explanation.zh: 研究方案计划使接受真干针或假干针的患者不知道自己接受的是哪一种。未接受针刺的患者会知道自己的分组，实施治疗的临床人员也无法对所提供的治疗设盲。盲法实际是否成功以及是否发生揭盲，需要结果论文才能核实。

explanation.en: Lower SPADI scores indicate less pain and disability. In this trial, a negative between-group difference favors PT + DN.
explanation.zh: SPADI 分数越低，表示疼痛与功能障碍越轻。在本试验中，组间差值为负数时，方向上有利于 PT + DN 组。

explanation.en: PASS records whether participants consider their current symptoms acceptable. The reported differences are absolute percentage-point differences in affirmative responses, not relative percentage improvements.
explanation.zh: PASS 记录患者是否认为目前的症状可以接受。报告的差值是回答“可以接受”的比例之绝对差值，单位为百分点，并非相对改善百分比。

explanation.en: Both 1-year SPADI confidence intervals include zero, so the primary comparisons did not reach statistical significance. This does not establish equivalence or prove that dry needling has no effect.
explanation.zh: 两项 1 年 SPADI 置信区间都包含 0，因此主要比较未达到统计学显著性。这并不等于证明各组等效，也不等于证明干针没有作用。

explanation.en: An odds ratio cannot be directly restated as a risk reduction, so the reported OR of 0.35 should not be described as a 65% reduction in risk. The abstract does not identify the reference group.
explanation.zh: 优势比不能直接改写为风险降低的比例，因此不能把报告的 OR 0.35 描述为“风险降低 65%”。摘要未说明参照组。

explanation.en: Multiplicity adjustment and adverse-event reporting have not been verified. Favorable secondary results therefore need separate appraisal rather than replacing the primary result.
explanation.zh: 多重比较校正与不良事件报告尚未核实。因此，有利的次要结果需要单独评价，不能用来替代主要结果。

explanation.en: The protocol planned analysis in the originally assigned groups. An intention-to-treat principle does not, by itself, solve missing-data bias; evaluating the estimates requires the actual analysis population, missing-data assumptions, and sensitivity analyses.
explanation.zh: 研究方案计划按照最初随机分配的组别进行分析。意向治疗原则本身并不能解决缺失数据带来的偏倚；评价效应估计，还需要了解实际分析人群、缺失数据假设与敏感性分析。

explanation.en: The planned sample was 130, and the results abstract reports 121 participants. This difference is not a count of participants lost to follow-up.
explanation.zh: 计划样本量为 130 人，结果摘要报告 121 名参与者。这一差额并不是失访人数。

term.zh: 预设结局与选择性报告

explanation.en: A wording difference between parts of a protocol does not, by itself, establish outcome switching. The dated protocol, registration history, and final report must be compared.
explanation.zh: 研究方案不同部分之间的措辞差异，本身不能认定发生了结局更换。仍需对照注明日期的研究方案、注册历史和最终报告。

explanation.en: A protocol records planned methods and cannot establish how the trial was actually conducted. Missing verification is not evidence that a method was omitted.
explanation.zh: 研究方案记录的是计划采用的方法，不能据此确认试验实际怎样执行。未能核实某项方法，不等于有证据表明研究未实施该方法。

title.en: Paper reading: the additional effects of dry needling
title.zh: 文章阅读：加用干针的额外获益

overview.en: A critical reading of a randomized trial that added dry needling to physical therapy for subacromial pain syndrome.
overview.zh: 批判性阅读一项随机试验：在物理治疗基础上加用干针治疗肩峰下疼痛综合征。

text.en: This appraisal uses the results abstract and the public study protocol. The full results article has not been obtained. A protocol records planned methods and cannot establish how the trial was actually conducted.
text.zh: 本节评价依据结果摘要与公开研究方案，尚未取得结果论文全文。研究方案记录的是计划采用的方法，不能据此确认试验实际怎样执行。

text.en: 6.1 Research question and comparison groups
text.zh: 6.1 研究问题与比较对象

text.en: In 121 participants with subacromial pain syndrome (SAPS), the trial compared physical therapy alone with physical therapy plus sham dry needling or dry needling. The primary outcome was the Shoulder Pain and Disability Index (SPADI) at 1 year.
text.zh: 试验纳入 121 名肩峰下疼痛综合征（SAPS）患者，比较单纯物理治疗、物理治疗加假干针，以及物理治疗加干针。主要结局是 1 年时的肩痛与功能障碍指数（SPADI）。

rows.en: Physical therapy plus sham dry needling

text.en: The PT comparison estimates the added effect of including dry needling in the treatment program. The sham comparison also accounts for aspects of receiving a needling procedure. These comparisons address different questions.
text.zh: 与 PT 组的比较估计在治疗方案中加入干针的额外效果；与假干针组的比较还考虑了接受针刺程序所涉及的部分因素。这两项比较回答的问题不同。

text.en: 6.2 Primary outcome: SPADI at 1 year
text.zh: 6.2 主要结局：1 年时的 SPADI

text.en: Lower SPADI scores indicate less pain and disability. A negative between-group difference favors PT + DN.
text.zh: SPADI 分数越低，表示疼痛与功能障碍越轻。组间差值为负数时，方向上有利于 PT + DN 组。

columns.zh: 比较：加用干针组减去对照组

text.en: Both confidence intervals include zero. The primary comparisons did not reach statistical significance; this does not establish equivalence or prove that dry needling has no effect. Estimates and intervals are reproduced as reported in the abstract.
text.zh: 两项置信区间都包含 0，主要比较未达到统计学显著性；这并不等于证明各组等效，也不等于证明干针没有作用。分差与区间按摘要所载记录，未自行修正。

text.en: 6.3 Secondary outcomes: symptom acceptability and health care use
text.zh: 6.3 次要结局：症状可接受状态与后续就医

text.en: The Patient Acceptable Symptom State (PASS) records whether participants consider their current symptoms acceptable. The differences below are absolute percentage-point differences in affirmative responses, not relative percentage improvements.
text.zh: 患者可接受症状状态（PASS）记录患者是否认为目前的症状可以接受。下表是回答“可以接受”的比例之绝对差值，单位为百分点，并非相对改善百分比。

rows.zh: 6 个月：PT + DN 对比 PT

rows.en: 6 months: PT + DN vs PT + SDN
rows.zh: 6 个月：PT + DN 对比 PT + SDN

rows.en: 1 year: PT + DN vs PT + SDN
rows.zh: 1 年：PT + DN 对比 PT + SDN

text.en: For additional shoulder-related care within 1 year, the reported odds ratio (OR) was 0.35 (95% CI, 0.13–0.95). The abstract does not identify the reference group. An odds ratio cannot be directly restated as a risk reduction; this value should not be described as a 65% reduction in risk.
text.zh: 对于入组后 1 年内再次因肩部问题就医，摘要报告的优势比（OR）为 0.35（95% 置信区间 0.13–0.95）。摘要未说明参照组。优势比不能直接改写为风险降低的比例，因此不能把这个数值描述为“风险降低 65%”。

text.en: 6.4 Methods appraisal and unresolved questions
text.zh: 6.4 方法评价与尚未核实的信息

text.en: Randomization, a sham comparator, and a public protocol support a more transparent comparison. The appraisal below separates planned methods from verified conduct. It is not a complete risk-of-bias assessment.
text.zh: 随机分组、假干针对照以及公开研究方案，使比较过程更便于追溯。以下评价区分计划采用的方法与已经核实的执行情况，并不构成完整的偏倚风险评价。

text.en: Randomization and allocation concealment
text.zh: 随机化与分配隐藏

text.en: Randomization determines group assignment; allocation concealment prevents advance knowledge of the next assignment during enrollment. The protocol planned sequentially numbered, opaque, sealed envelopes. Whether this procedure was implemented adequately remains unverified.
text.zh: 随机化用于确定分组；分配隐藏用于防止在入组过程中提前知道下一次分配结果。研究方案计划采用顺序编号、不透明且密封的信封。该程序是否得到充分落实，仍未核实。

text.en: Blinding and outcome measurement
text.zh: 盲法与结局测量

text.en: The protocol planned to blind participants receiving real or sham needling to that distinction. Participants in the no-needling group would know their assignment, and treating clinicians could not be blinded to the treatment delivered. Actual masking success and unmasking require the results report.
text.zh: 研究方案计划使接受真干针或假干针的患者不知道自己接受的是哪一种。未接受针刺的患者会知道自己的分组，实施治疗的临床人员也无法对所提供的治疗设盲。盲法实际是否成功以及是否发生揭盲，需要结果论文才能核实。

text.en: Prespecified outcomes and selective reporting
text.zh: 预设结局与选择性报告

text.en: The protocol abstract lists SPADI and PROMIS-57, whereas its statistical section specifies 1-year SPADI as the primary endpoint. This wording difference alone does not establish outcome switching. The dated protocol, registration history, and final report must be compared.
text.zh: 研究方案摘要列出 SPADI 和 PROMIS-57，但其统计部分将 1 年时的 SPADI 明确定为主要终点。仅凭这处措辞差异，不能认定发生了结局更换。仍需对照注明日期的研究方案、注册历史和最终报告。

text.en: Sample size, attrition, and missing data
text.zh: 样本量、失访与缺失数据

text.en: The planned sample was 130; the results abstract reports 121 participants. This difference is not a count of participants lost to follow-up. Group-specific missingness, reasons for dropout, and the analysis of incomplete outcomes remain unverified.
text.zh: 计划样本量为 130 人，结果摘要报告 121 名参与者。这一差额并不是失访人数。各组缺失数据的分布、退出原因，以及不完整结局的分析方式，仍未核实。

text.en: The protocol planned analysis in the originally assigned groups. An intention-to-treat principle does not, by itself, solve missing-data bias. Evaluating the estimates requires the actual analysis population, missing-data assumptions, and sensitivity analyses.
text.zh: 研究方案计划按照最初随机分配的组别进行分析。意向治疗原则本身并不能解决缺失数据带来的偏倚。评价效应估计，还需要了解实际分析人群、缺失数据假设与敏感性分析。

text.en: Multiplicity, harms, and health care ascertainment
text.zh: 多重比较、不良事件与就医信息来源

text.en: Multiplicity adjustment and adverse-event reporting have not been verified. Favorable secondary results therefore need separate appraisal rather than replacing the primary result. The protocol planned database and record-based health care data, whereas the results abstract describes self-report; this difference and the OR reference group remain unresolved.
text.zh: 多重比较校正与不良事件报告尚未核实。因此，有利的次要结果需要单独评价，不能用来替代主要结果。研究方案计划通过数据库及病历收集就医数据，结果摘要则描述为患者自报；这一差异以及 OR 的参照组仍待厘清。

text.en: The paper identifies trial registration NCT03442894. The current registry contents and amendment history have not been verified in this appraisal. Missing verification is not evidence that a method was omitted.
text.zh: 论文注明的试验登记号为 NCT03442894。本次评价尚未核验注册页面的当前内容与修改历史。未能核实某项方法，不等于有证据表明研究未实施该方法。

text.en: 6.5 Interpretation and applicability
text.zh: 6.5 结论与适用范围

text.en: The trial did not establish an additional benefit on 1-year SPADI. Favorable secondary findings warrant cautious, outcome-specific interpretation. The results cannot be generalized to every dry-needling protocol, all shoulder pain, or acupuncture as a whole.
text.zh: 这项试验未能在 1 年 SPADI 上确立额外获益。有利的次要发现应按具体结局谨慎解释。结果不能推广到所有干针方案、全部肩痛患者，或针灸整体。

text.en: References
